prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: a single new ribbon toolbar pictogram for Federation Audit, a professional Windows BIM model-list completeness checker. Square, true transparent background. Match a compact blue engineering icon family: bold faceted isometric cobalt blue cube #1769D2 and navy #123D73, pale cyan #B7E4FF. Place a short pale-blue upright checklist overlapping the cube's lower right, with two strong blue ticks and one short blue line. The cube represents the federated model and the checklist verifies its source model list. One unified simple silhouette, only a cube plus checklist. Fill 84 percent of canvas; bold large shapes, simple flat-vector-like geometry and clean edges; crisp when downsampled to 16 or 32 px. No fine details, no text, letters, numbers, watermark, background tile, drop shadow, green or gradients. Avoid a magnifying glass or export arrow so it is distinct from other tools.
